metadata.name: Email Trigger
metadata.summary: Start a Greentic flow when mail arrives in an IMAP mailbox
metadata.description: Ships the email trigger nodeType (trigger contract v1, email_imap kind: greentic-start polls the mailbox and starts the flow for each new message, entering it at the node after the trigger) plus one design-time tool (validate_email_trigger). The password is never stored in the flow: the node names a secret.
